verdict.rationale: Managed annual-report preparation and filing is a fair axis for a registered agent provider, so the story applies, but the pack has no evidence of it. The only probe shows the site was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, so nothing first-party was fetched. The single community comment only remarks on the company's SEO and says nothing about annual reports.

support.subject: As a founder, I can have the provider prepare and file my annual reports as a managed service or add-on
